# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 10, Serye ng 2018 — Cockfighting Franchise Guidelines

## Summary

This ordinance establishes comprehensive guidelines and rules for granting cockfighting (sabungan) franchise operations within the territorial jurisdiction of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]]. Authored by [[Konsehal Adam M. Forbes]] of the Committee on Agriculture and Environmental Protection, the ordinance is organized into chapters: Chapter 1 covers General Provisions and Chapter 2 covers the Legal and Policy Basis. It references [[Sec-16-RA7160]] (General Welfare Clause), [[Sec-22-RA7160]] (Corporate Powers), and [[Sec-447-RA7160]], specifically Section 447(a)(3)(v) which empowers the Sangguniang Bayan to authorize and license cockfighting and regulate the establishment and operation of cockpits. [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] was absent during the session. This ordinance was later amended by [[MO-04-S2023]].

## Key Provisions

- Chapter 1: General Provisions establishing the framework for cockfighting franchise regulation.
- Chapter 2: Legal and Policy Basis citing [[Sec-16-RA7160]] (general welfare) and [[Sec-22-RA7160]] (corporate powers).
- Establishes rules and guidelines for granting franchise to operate cockpits (sabungan) within [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
- Exercises the specific power of the Sangguniang Bayan under Section 447(a)(3)(v) of [[RA 7160]] to authorize cockfighting activity.
- Regulates the establishment, operation, and maintenance of cockpit arenas.

- [[Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo]]

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-16-RA7160]] — General Welfare Clause.
- [[Sec-22-RA7160]] — Corporate Powers of LGUs.
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, and functions of the Sangguniang Bayan.
- Section 447(a)(3)(v) of [[RA 7160]] — Specific power to authorize and license cockfighting and regulate cockpit operations.

## Related Ordinances

- [[MO-04-S2023]] — Amends this ordinance to expand territorial coverage of cockfighting franchise operations.

## Related DILG Legal Opinions

- [[LO-0124-S2024]] — Whether a Municipal Mayor can issue a special permit for cockfighting during a local fiesta.
- [[LO-0129-S2024]] — Whether the law should be interpreted to mean a singular cockpit for the entire city.
